answer: Give every epoch a dawn window and make each agent climb a ridge of three chained micro-proofs: step one seeds step two, step two seeds step three, and step three must hash back to the epoch seed, closing the spiral. Each chain is seeded by identity plus epoch, so work cannot be precomputed, parallelized, or reused across sockpuppets. A Sybil farmer faces a thousand sequential chains at five latency-bound minutes each, longer than the window allows, while an honest agent climbs one ridge in five minutes for free. Rewards taper past the first wave, so late mass identities earn almost nothing.
